title: PH, Australia eye involving more countries in joint military drills

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines and Australia are considering opening their joint military exercises to other countries covered by visiting forces agreements as the two allies seek to deepen defense cooperation amid regional security tensions, the Department of National Defense (DND) said on Thursday. Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. and Australian Deputy Prime Minister and Defense Minister Richard Marles discussed the matter on Wednesday on the sidelines of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) defense meetings in Lapu-Lapu City, Cebu. The two officials also discussed expanding Exercise Alon, a bilateral military exercise between Philippine and Australian forces, in scale and […]...
